article_context: 从美国山火挤占联邦预算谈起，指出仅把问题归因于气候变化过于简单；人类社会、土地利用与火灾彼此关联，政策上需要学会与不可避免的火共存。

article.title: 阅读 Text 4 · 面对山火，人类需要改变看火的方式
article.background: 从美国山火挤占联邦预算谈起，指出仅把问题归因于气候变化过于简单；人类社会、土地利用与火灾彼此关联，政策上需要学会与不可避免的火共存。

sentences.en: Though often viewed as a problem for western states, the growing frequency of wildfires is a national concern because of its impact on federal tax dollars, says Professor Max Moritz, a specialist in fire ecology and management.
sentences.zh: 火生态与管理专家马克斯·莫里茨教授指出，虽然山火常被视为美国西部各州的问题，但由于其对联邦税款支出的影响，山火日益频繁其实是一个全国性问题。

segments.text: Though often viewed as a problem for western states, the growing frequency of wildfires is a national concern because of its impact on federal tax dollars, says Professor Max Moritz, a specialist in fire ecology and management.

sentences.en: In 2015, the US Forest Service for the first time spent more than half of its $5.5 billion annual budget fighting fires - nearly double the percentage it spent on such efforts 20 years ago.
sentences.zh: 2015年，美国林务局首次将其55亿美元年度预算的一半以上用于灭火，这一占比几乎是20年前的两倍。

segments.text: In 2015, the US Forest Service for the first time spent more than half of its $5.5 billion annual budget fighting fires - nearly double the percentage it spent on such efforts 20 years ago.

sentences.en: In effect, fewer federal funds today are going towards the agency's other work - such as forest conservation, watershed and cultural resources management, and infrastructure upkeep - that affect the lives of all Americans.
sentences.zh: 这实际上意味着，如今用于该机构其他工作的联邦资金更少了——例如森林保护、流域与文化资源管理以及基础设施维护，而这些工作都关系到所有美国人的生活。

segments.text: In effect, fewer federal funds today are going towards the agency's other work - such as forest conservation, watershed and cultural resources management, and infrastructure upkeep - that affect the lives of all Americans.

sentences.en: Another nationwide concern is whether public funds from other agencies are going into construction in fire-prone districts.
sentences.zh: 另一个全国性问题是，其他政府机构的公共资金是否正被投入火灾高风险地区的建设。

segments.text: Another nationwide concern is whether public funds from other agencies are going into construction in fire-prone districts.

sentences.en: As Moritz puts it, how often are federal dollars building homes that are likely to be lost to a wildfire?
sentences.zh: 正如莫里茨所问：联邦资金究竟有多少次是在建造那些很可能被山火烧毁的房屋？

segments.text: As Moritz puts it, how often are federal dollars building homes that are likely to be lost to a wildfire?

sentences.en: "It's already a huge problem from a public expenditure perspective for the whole country," he says.
sentences.zh: 他说：“从全国公共支出的角度看，这已经是一个巨大的问题。”

segments.text: "It's already a huge problem from a public expenditure perspective for the whole country," he says.

sentences.en: "We need to take a magnifying glass to that.
sentences.zh: “我们需要拿放大镜好好审视这件事。

segments.text: "We need to take a magnifying glass to that.

sentences.en: Like, "Wait a minute, is this OK?"
sentences.zh: 比如问一句：‘等等，这样做真的合适吗？’

segments.text: Like, "Wait a minute, is this OK?"

sentences.en: Do we want instead to redirect those funds to concentrate on lower-hazard parts of the landscape?"
sentences.zh: 我们是不是应该把这些资金转而集中投入风险较低的地区？”

segments.text: Do we want instead to redirect those funds to concentrate on lower-hazard parts of the landscape?"

sentences.en: Such a view would require a corresponding shift in the way US society today views fire, researchers say.
sentences.zh: 研究人员说，这种看法要求美国社会相应改变如今看待火灾的方式。

segments.text: Such a view would require a corresponding shift in the way US society today views fire, researchers say.

sentences.en: For one thing, conversations about wildfires need to be more inclusive.
sentences.zh: 首先，关于山火的讨论需要纳入更多因素。

segments.text: For one thing, conversations about wildfires need to be more inclusive.

sentences.en: Over the past decade, the focus has been on climate change - how the warming of the Earth from greenhouse gases is leading to conditions that worsen fires.
sentences.zh: 过去十年，人们关注的重点一直是气候变化——温室气体导致地球变暖，从而形成使火灾更严重的条件。

segments.text: Over the past decade, the focus has been on climate change - how the warming of the Earth from greenhouse gases is leading to conditions that worsen fires.

sentences.en: While climate is a key element, Moritz says, it shouldn't come at the expense of the rest of the equation.
sentences.zh: 莫里茨说，气候固然是关键因素，但不应因此忽视整个问题中的其他部分。

segments.text: While climate is a key element, Moritz says, it shouldn't come at the expense of the rest of the equation.

sentences.en: "The human systems and the landscapes we live on are linked, and the interactions go both ways," he says.
sentences.zh: 他说：“人类系统与我们生活的土地彼此相连，而且这种相互作用是双向的。”

segments.text: "The human systems and the landscapes we live on are linked, and the interactions go both ways," he says.

sentences.en: Failing to recognize that, he notes, leads to "an overly simplified view of what the solutions might be.
sentences.zh: 他指出，如果认识不到这一点，就会“把可能的解决方案看得过于简单。

segments.text: Failing to recognize that, he notes, leads to "an overly simplified view of what the solutions might be.

sentences.en: Our perception of the problem and of what the solution is becomes very limited."
sentences.zh: 我们对问题本身以及解决办法的理解都会变得非常局限。”

segments.text: Our perception of the problem and of what the solution is becomes very limited."

sentences.en: At the same time, people continue to treat fire as an event that needs to be wholly controlled and unleashed only out of necessity, says Professor Balch at the University of Colorado.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，科罗拉多大学的鲍尔奇教授说，人们仍把火视为一种必须彻底控制、只有在必要时才可放开的现象。

segments.text: At the same time, people continue to treat fire as an event that needs to be wholly controlled and unleashed only out of necessity, says Professor Balch at the University of Colorado.

sentences.en: But acknowledging fire's inevitable presence in human life is an attitude crucial to developing the laws, policies, and practices that make it as safe as possible, she says.
sentences.zh: 但她指出，承认火在人类生活中不可避免地存在，是制定法律、政策和实践、尽可能降低其风险所必需的态度。

segments.text: But acknowledging fire's inevitable presence in human life is an attitude crucial to developing the laws, policies, and practices that make it as safe as possible, she says.

sentences.en: "We've disconnected ourselves from living with fire," Balch says.
sentences.zh: 鲍尔奇说：“我们已经把自己与‘和火共处’这件事割裂开来。”

segments.text: "We've disconnected ourselves from living with fire," Balch says.

sentences.en: "It is really important to understand and try and tease out what is the human connection with fire today."
sentences.zh: “理解并努力厘清今天人类与火之间究竟是什么关系，真的非常重要。”

segments.text: "It is really important to understand and try and tease out what is the human connection with fire today."
